name: Corpse Storm - Full Army Zoo Updated Defenses

children.text: IMPORTANT: Use the Mephisto Seasonal Splinter, Ghosts of Odium, as it increases your Pit Push speed significantly.

NOTE: It's important that you get 4.5 out of 4.5 block chance per resolve stack on your Kullean Prism version of Aspect of Interdiction for your amulet otherwise with 23 resolve stacks, you won't get 100% block chance which we need to full power our amulet's Aspect of Redirected Force.

We need all 6 resistances, and get Fire and Poison from our socketed splinters.  This leaves Cold, Shadow, Physical, and Lightning.  You aren't going to get resistances on your Mythic charms and still get Darkness skills, so put two resistances on your Set Charms, and the other two resistances that are left on your helm and boots.

Get as many multis as possible, prioritizing critical strike, then vulnerable, then shadow multis.  Get 100% crit chance, with the knowledge that we get 46% critical strike chance  and 46% attack speed from Pact of Bone, 20% attack speed from Ferocity stacks, 20% attack speed from Splinter of Anguish, 99% cast speed from Golem Aura, 6.3% attack speed and 8.8% summon attack speed from paragon board, getting us to our 100% attack speed cap needed for Cult Leader.  Therefore we need 55% Critical Strike Chance (50% if you use Critical Strike Blood Mist), where we get 20% from Splinter of Anguish, 15% from our weapon temper, 5% from base crit chance, and another 5% or so from one crit affix on our gear, either a lucky transfig (preferably on boots) or one affix on gloves or rings.  With Critical Strike Blood Mist, we reach 100% crit chance with almost no to no crit chance on gear affixes, freeing up space for extra multis for damage.  This is really unusual and boosts our damage significantly, and will make your gear search easier.

With us losing movement speed from our Splinter of Pain, we use a movement speed affix and temper on our boots, as well as movement speed on Enigma and Infinity and from Blood Mad Idol, to get close to our 215% movement speed overcap (we are overcapped from berserking from Blood Mad Idol, so we have a possible 215% movement speed instead of 200%).
Endurant Faith gives us insane survivability and also permanently keeps the Berserking buff from Blood Mad Idol up, which surprisingly boosts our DPS while using a defensive item.

We use Aspect of Reanimation on a legendary ring as our minions are always alive anyways, and it's otherwise unheard of to get a 90%x damage multiplier on a ring aspect for shadow minions.  There's not another Mythic for this spot that is better.
Enchant off Gold Find on your Infinity for Critical Strike Damage Multiplier.  Very important.

If you're lucky enough to get Gem Strength as a Transfig for one of your rings or amulet, socket Splinter of the Black Soulstone in that item.  Try to also get All Stats as a transfig on one of your rings, so that we can use +4 to Darkness skills on both Set Charms.  Otherwise, use one Set Charm that is +125 to All Stats instead so we get to the 530 Willpower cap.

Blood Moon Breeches makes our summons (wolves included) apply curses, so we don't need to slot Iron Maiden or Decrepify, and get a bonus 78%x critical strike damage from Blood Moon Breeches, which is insane damage for pants which are usually a defense item.

Using Corpse Mages at the expense of 2 mages allows us to ignore essence generation on our gear, as each Mage provides over 200% essence generation just for existing.  This is important as our mobility from Enigma is tied to essence, as well as periodically spawning Mages and using Blood Lance.
I've included ideal stat priorities, top to bottom.
Nagu doesn't proc Pact of Bone with Ceh like BacCeh, so this minion build uses NaguSol for extra damage reduction.
For Hellfire Torch, we use a Rathma Torch with +5 to All Skills.

Darkness Skills is slightly better for charms as it boosts our Iron Maiden damage as well, however Minion Skills is also very good.  Our minions are both minions and darkness so they both boost our primary damage.
We use 3x Rathma set for 60%x damage, as well as 3 Unique Charms for 130%x, 130%x, and 163%x bonus damage, while still allowing a 180%x multiplier on our amulet.

We use Hewed Flesh as Utility Aspect for Boots as it generates corpses needed for Gravekeeper and spawning skeletons, and boosts both our Corpse Mages and Warriors damage by 20%x.  Our Overpower and Ferocity stacks are generated by lucky hit chance on our curses, which is more than sufficient for the low amount of stacks we have of each (4 Overpower and 4 Ferocity), and we can generate the 23 Resolve needed for Redirected Force and our massive amulet 180%x multiplier this way as well, while freeing up Banished Lord's Talisman to be a charm for us instead.  We gain our Fortify from Blood Mist and Iron Maiden kills, as well as when we use Blood Lance.  This allows us to remove fortify from our gear and use Life instead.

It is important tocontinually use Blood Lance, as this is our way of spending Overpower stacks, which is how we get the 195%x damage from our Banished Lord's Talisman, and also generates Overpower from spending resource, and also fortifies us and applies Corruption which boosts our damage from our Wither paragon nodes.

We use Barrier Mages over the DPS alternative as we desperately need the sustain to support our Endurant Faith and Blood Mad Idol combination.  This is the same reason we use the Blood version of Decrepify.

Because we have corpses that spawn from Hewed Flesh, we can instead use the Passive Bonus and Damage Bonus versions of Army of the Dead, which keeps our Summoning Damage multiplier active constantly, at the expense of corpse spawning, which is ok because we get our corpses anyways from Hewed Flesh.
Use the Leveling Board first, then restructure slightly to the Endgame Board for maximum amount of free points.

We use Mage on Wither and Warrior on Scent of Death for insane Summon Damage and Summon Damage multis, with Essence filling out our damage on the highest stat board for Essence (Blood Begets Blood) as critical strike damage is extremely important, with Deadraiser on Cult Leader and Gravekeeper on Starter giving a nice boost to Summon Damage, Damage to Elites, and Damage, for a low paragon node investment.

With this setup you should reach the 530 Willpower cutoff we need to activate every node (Dexterity and Intelligence are covered easily), however if you don't, sacrifice a few Blue Nodes of your choice (probably Armor or % Damage from Overpower Stacks on Blood Begets Blood) to add some Blue Willpower Nodes to reach 530.
For Mercenary we use Varyana for an attack speed buff, and our Reinforcement should be Aldkin in order to reduce incoming damage from our enemies.
These are my favorites and will yield a boosted amount of loot and experience, while providing the best opportunities for completing The Pit quickly.
PHEW.
Enjoy absolutely deleting and face tanking end game content.

Included is a loot filter to save high end content while still showing low tier gear that you can use to craft Uniques at the cube, which can then be upgraded into Mythic Uniques.  Downgrade the ancestral blue and yellow gear to common by removing affixes (and use common ancestral gear as is), then upgrade to unique in order to have a chance at a free Unique that can be used to craft a Mythic Unique.  When you don't want to see these ancestral common, blue, and yellow drops, disable Rule #2 in the loot filter.

weaknesses: Damage Taken Turned into DoT Which Can Outdo Our Sustain
